Interactive Tucson Stories

Choose your Tucson problem.

Start with something ordinary. Make one reasonable decision. Then watch Tucson turn it into a situation. No local knowledge required.

The Pothole That Built a SubwayA routine street repair uncovers Tucson's most efficiently completed transit project. The Doctor Is a Data CenterA newcomer searches for a primary-care doctor and discovers the county's best-kept server farm. The Crossing That Wouldn't OpenOne freight train, two meetings, and Cortaro Road's longest unofficial neighborhood gathering. The Gem Show Ate DowntownA harmless mineral purchase expands into a temporary international government. But It's a Dry HeatA new snowbird attempts July with confidence, optimism, and one decorative water bottle. The Jurisdiction LineOne fallen traffic sign lands in Tucson, Marana, and unincorporated Pima County at the same time. The Last Sonoran Hot DogA missing cart, a secret recipe, and Tucson's least neutral food investigation. The Boneyard Restroom ConnectionA 35-minute flight to Phoenix adds one unscheduled stop and an increasingly urgent question. Signs of TroubleYou were only trying to cross Tucson.
